{{Top|leg}}
'''Epoxy armor''' was a type of building material. It was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to reinforce command center and armories in their outposts.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
